findings.title: The highlighted bar in the weekday chart has no stated reason

location.description: The "Output by array" bar chart, the dark blue bar for array F.

findings.viewer_experience: One bar is picked out in blue and labelled 2.3 MWh, but nothing says why it is the one, so a viewer cannot tell if it is the best, the worst, or selected.

current.value: One blue bar among grey bars, with only its value above it.

findings.target: A viewer can tell from the chart alone why one bar is highlighted.
findings.fix_direction: Say in the chart what the highlight means, for example in the title or a short note.
findings.source: Tufte, The Visual Display of Quantitative Information

closed_when.check: Look at the chart: a label or note tells you why array F is highlighted.

findings.title: The fault text sits far from the array names in the table

location.description: The "Arrays needing a visit" table, between the Array and Fault columns.

findings.viewer_experience: The reader's eye has to cross a wide gap to match each array with its fault.

current.value: A wide empty gap between the array name and its fault text.

findings.target: The array name and its fault are read as one row without effort.
findings.fix_direction: Tighten the column widths so each row reads together.

closed_when.check: Look at the table: each array and its fault read as one line.
